detail.title: INTEX AIR KING HC 70 Air Cooler – 70 Litres
detail.overview: Low Power Consumption | Long Air Throw | Inverter-compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty Overview Beat the sweltering summer heat with the Intex Air King HC 70, a high-performance desert air cooler designed for modern homeowners who value both comfort and efficiency. Ideal for cooling medium-to-large bedrooms, halls, or study areas, this energy-efficient air cooler pushes a massive 17-metre air throw. Equipped with a generous 70-litre water tank, the Air King HC 70 ensures uninterrupted, overnight cooling without the need for constant refills. Its high-density 3-side honeycomb pads and dedicated ice chamber guarantee a rapid temperature drop, while the inverter-compatible motor provides peace of mind during power cuts. Built with a durable, rust-proof body and 360-degree castor wheels, this cooler offers long-lasting performance and easy mobility. Experience superior air delivery and a refreshing environment all season long with one of the best high-capacity air coolers from Intex. Product Highlights Long Air Throw With an impressive air throw of up to 17 meters, this air cooler is ideal for living rooms, large bedrooms, offices, restaurants, and open spaces. Energy-Efficient & Inverter Compatible Designed to deliver powerful cooling while consuming less power, this air cooler is inverter compatible, so you stay cool even during power cuts or voltage fluctuations. High-Efficiency Honeycomb Cooling Pads The 3-sided Honeycomb cooling pads allow 45% extra water retention, which results in 25% extra cooling, making this cooler perfect for hot and dry climates. 3-Speed Fan & 4-Way Air Deflection Choose from three speed settings to suit your comfort. The 4-way air deflection system ensures even airflow, with vertical louvres for side movement and horizontal louvres for upward and downward airflow. Durable Build & Easy Mobility Featuring a double ball bearing motor, the cooler is built for long-lasting performance. 360-degree castor wheels make it easy to move across rooms with minimal effort. Ice Chamber Add ice or ice packs to enjoy extra cooling during peak summer heat, delivering a faster and more refreshing airflow when you need it most. Collapsible Louvres The fully collapsible louvres make cleaning simple and maintenance easy, helping maintain efficient cooling performance season after season. Water level indicator A quick glance lets you know exactly when it's time to refill the tank. Say goodbye to guesswork and ensure your cooling is never interrupted. Voltage Fluctuation T.O.P. motor cover Your cooler's motor is protected against sudden power surges and drops in voltage. This ensures safe, stable operation and extends the lifespan of your appliance. 1-year warranty Complete peace of mind with a 1-year manufacturer warranty, ensuring reliable performance and dependable after-sales support. Ideal For: Large bedrooms, substantial living rooms, or medium-sized offices. They balance high capacity with ease of mobility, perfect for general home use in dry climates.
